dashboard.label: SOC Lab Overview
dashboard.description: Synthetic Harbor Lab data. Time range: 2026-03-14.

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}) port" | stats count BY src_ip | sort - count | head 10

panel.title: Logins that followed a brute-force burst (DET-02)

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") | rex "(?<result>Failed|Accepted) (?<method>password|publickey) for (?:invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}) port" | where isnotnull(result) | sort 0 _time | streamstats time_window=10m count(eval(result="Failed")) AS failures_last_10m BY src_ip | where result="Accepted" AND failures_last_10m >= 10 | table _time host user src_ip method failures_last_10m

index=soc_lab sourcetype=sysmon:json EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*\\WINWORD.EXE" OR ParentImage="*\\EXCEL.EXE") (Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR Image="*\\powershell.exe") | table _time Computer User ParentImage Image

index=soc_lab sourcetype=sysmon:json EventCode=3 Initiated=true (Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Image="*\\wscript.exe") | where NOT cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", DestinationIp) | stats count BY Computer Image DestinationIp DestinationPort
